name: Capybara Cafe Chronicles
source:
"Capybara Cafe Chronicles is a cozy blend of romance visual novel and relaxing puzzle game—set in a charming cafe run entirely by capybaras.

To escape your financial hardship, you’ve taken a job at a quiet little coffee shop in a sleepy town—where the locals are kind, the pastries are warm, and the capybaras? Well… they talk, wear little aprons, and might just steal your heart. And did we say, they have handsome human forms at night?!"

[From [url=https://littlesnakestudio.itch.io/capybara-cafe-chronicles]itch.io[/url]]
